Use when p95 latency or data freshness matters — realtime dashboards, market data, streaming agents, queues, or caches.

9: 
10: # Latency Critical Systems
11: 
12: Use this skill when the user cares about realtime behavior, hot paths, streaming
13: freshness, or execution speed. This includes HFT-like infrastructure, but the
14: skill is engineering-focused. It does not authorize live trading or financial
15: advice.
16: 
17: ## Split The Metrics
18: 
19: Do not collapse everything into "fast." Track:
20: 
21: - p50, p95, and p99 latency;
22: - throughput;
23: - freshness age;
24: - queue depth;
25: - cache hit rate;
26: - provider/API response time;
27: - browser render time;
28: - correctness under load;
29: - failure and retry behavior.
30: 
31: ## Map The Hot Path
32: 
33: Write the path from user/event to final visible state:
34: 
35: ```text
36: source event -> provider API -> ingest worker -> queue -> cache -> edge route
37: -> client stream -> browser render -> user-visible state
38: ```
39: 
40: Then measure each segment separately.
41: 
42: ## Optimization Order
43: 
44: 1. Remove unnecessary round trips.
45: 2. Cache stable reads with freshness metadata.
46: 3. Batch small calls and writes.
47: 4. Move compute closer to the data or the user.
48: 5. Split hot and cold paths.
49: 6. Apply backpressure before queues grow unbounded.
50: 7. Use streaming only when it improves freshness or user experience.
51: 8. Add canaries for stale data, degraded providers, and bad cache state.
52: 
53: ## Verification
54: 
55: Use live readbacks when a deployed surface exists:
56: 
57: - HTTP timing and response headers;
58: - provider freshness timestamp;
59: - queue or job state;
60: - edge/cache state;
61: - browser verification for actual UI freshness;
62: - logs around retries and degraded mode.
63: 
64: For market-data or execution-adjacent paths, also verify orderbook age, VWAP
65: assumptions, provider status, and kill-switch behavior before calling the path
66: ready.
67: 
68: ## Guardrails
69: 
70: - Do not optimize latency by dropping required validation.
71: - Do not hide stale data behind fast cache hits.
72: - Do not claim millisecond behavior from client labels without measurement.
73: - Do not run live orders, destructive migrations, or customer-impacting deploys
74:   without an explicit approval gate.
75: - Keep secrets and private payloads out of logs and benchmark artifacts."}}
